dialogue.speaker: Professor Lumen
dialogue.text: Our region changes with every path a Trainer chooses.

dialogue.speaker: Professor Lumen
dialogue.text: Travel with your Pokémon, study the wild habitats, and earn the trust of each Gym.

dialogue.speaker: Professor Lumen
dialogue.text: Begin in the Forest. Your first discovery is waiting beyond the trail.

dialogue.speaker: Professor Lumen
dialogue.text: Notice how the grass shifts. Every habitat shelters a different community of Pokémon.

dialogue.speaker: Professor Lumen
dialogue.text: Explore carefully, then challenge the Volt Gym when your team is ready.

dialogue.speaker: Archivist Mira
dialogue.text: The Volt Badge is more than proof of victory. It marks the first step beyond familiar roads.

dialogue.speaker: Archivist Mira
dialogue.text: New routes are opening. Let your team grow through every challenge.

dialogue.speaker: Field Note
dialogue.text: Fresh marks cross the stone, but they do not match the tracks near the entrance.

dialogue.speaker: Field Note
dialogue.text: Something deep in the cave is disturbing the wild Pokémon.

dialogue.speaker: Professor Lumen
dialogue.text: Three badges already. Your Pokémon are not simply stronger; they trust your decisions.

dialogue.speaker: Professor Lumen
dialogue.text: Keep watching the habitats. Unusual signs are appearing across the region.

dialogue.speaker: Ranger Sol
dialogue.text: The vents are calm, yet the instruments keep detecting waves of heat.

dialogue.speaker: Ranger Sol
dialogue.text: Whatever caused them moved toward the high country.

dialogue.speaker: Archivist Mira
dialogue.text: Reports from distant routes describe the same pulse you found in the wilds.

dialogue.speaker: Archivist Mira
dialogue.text: The pattern points toward the Mountain and the old Graveyard.

dialogue.speaker: Archivist Mira
dialogue.text: That light above the ridge is no storm. Ancient records call it a skyward signal.

dialogue.speaker: Archivist Mira
dialogue.text: We are close to understanding why rare Pokémon have begun to stir.

dialogue.speaker: Old Memorial
dialogue.text: The carved letters feel warm beneath the moonlight: When sky and shadow answer, the final road appears.

dialogue.speaker: Archivist Mira
dialogue.text: The memorial and the mountain describe the same device: an ancient Aether Beacon above the ridge.

dialogue.speaker: Archivist Mira
dialogue.text: Its broken resonance is echoing through every habitat. The cave, volcano, and restless sky are one disturbance.

dialogue.speaker: Archivist Mira
dialogue.text: Return to the Mountain. Professor Lumen and Ranger Sol are tracing the source.

dialogue.speaker: Ranger Sol
dialogue.text: The wind stops at this stone ring, then surges outward toward every route.

dialogue.speaker: Professor Lumen
dialogue.text: The Beacon once balanced natural energy. Its fractured core is amplifying the region's own pulse instead.

dialogue.speaker: Professor Lumen
dialogue.text: Something above us is pushing back against it.

dialogue.speaker: Rhea Vale
dialogue.text: That shape in the clouds is not causing the pulse. Rayquaza is trying to contain it.

dialogue.speaker: Ranger Sol
dialogue.text: The Beacon is overloading. If its next wave reaches the lowlands, every habitat will feel it.

dialogue.speaker: Rhea Vale
dialogue.text: Then we reach Rayquaza first and prove we came to help.

dialogue.speaker: Archivist Mira
dialogue.text: The old record is clear: the guardian answers courage, not control.

dialogue.speaker: Rhea Vale
dialogue.text: I'll stabilize the Beacon with Lumen. You and your team take the final path.

dialogue.speaker: Rhea Vale
dialogue.text: Stand with Rayquaza. Let it see what this region means to us.

dialogue.speaker: Professor Lumen
dialogue.text: The Beacon is quiet. Rayquaza carried its excess energy harmlessly beyond the clouds.

dialogue.speaker: Ranger Sol
dialogue.text: Temperatures are settling, the cave echoes have faded, and the habitats are calm again.

dialogue.speaker: Rhea Vale
dialogue.text: We found the answer together. Now take that same trust to the Pokémon League.

dialogue.speaker: Professor Lumen
dialogue.text: Eight badges. The Pokémon League now recognizes you as a challenger.

dialogue.speaker: Professor Lumen
dialogue.text: Prepare every member of your party. The hardest road begins here.
